name: javelin_throw
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D pixel-art sprite sheet for Ruby1, FOUR sequential javelin THROW animation frames, transparent background. Reference image1 is the authoritative Viridy identity: muscular jade green anthropomorphic lion, long swept-back jade/celadon mane, closed feline muzzle, pale eyes, bronze-black segmented shoulder armor, charcoal forearm and shin wraps, dark torn loincloth, long green tail. Reference image2 shows pixel style and full body proportions. Create new poses, preserving exactly that character and palette. Action: fast overhead javelin throw, facing RIGHT in every frame. Frame1: feet planted in low athletic stance, torso coiled, throwing elbow drawn behind and ABOVE shoulder, hand gripping long slender spectral jade fire spear horizontally over shoulder, spear tip pointing RIGHT. Frame2: shoulder drives forward, elbow high, arm accelerates overhead, weight forward. Frame3: forceful release, arm reaching diagonally forward/right at shoulder height, hand OPEN now, NO spear in hand, chest twists forward. Frame4: follow-through, empty throwing arm extends downward/forward, weight on leading leg, mane and tail trailing left, returning to fighting stance. The javelin has a thin mint-white luminous shaft and sharpened jade flame spearhead, NOT a fireball or knife. Spear appears only in first TWO frames; last TWO hands empty. Mouth CLOSED throughout, no roaring. Strict grid TWO columns TWO rows, exactly FOUR fullbody sprites; consistent body scale and feet baseline in each equal cell, 32px transparent margins including whole spear, no cropping or touching neighboring cells. Palette original jade/celadon and dark outlines, crisp arcade pixel clusters, no smooth paint or blurry glow. No labels, text, ground, grids, scenery, VFX halos or additional figures.

name: spirit_spear
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 2D arcade pixel art animated projectile sheet, FOUR JADE SPIRIT FIRE SPEARS on a genuinely transparent background. Reference is the existing jade spiritual flame's dark emerald/jade/celadon palette and sharp pixel clusters only. Create a long SLENDER JAVELIN made of spiritual green fire, pointing horizontally RIGHT. Clearly readable straight thin mint-white luminous SHAFT along most of its length, with a large sharply tapered leaf-shaped lance TIP on right and short streaming jade flame wisps along shaft and tail on left. Not a fireball, not a knife, not a staff with a jewel, no metal. Four sequential flicker frames: identical shaft alignment, tip location and overall length, only small flame wisps and luminous internal streaks animate. Four separate complete sprites in STRICT TWO columns TWO rows, centered in equal wide cells. Each spear's silhouette width about FOUR TIMES its height, generous 32px transparent margin all around. Pixel-art, crisp limited jade green and pale celadon palette, deep jade edge, very bright ivory-mint center, restrained translucency ONLY at edges, no blur, no surrounding painted glow/cloud or backdrop. Transparent empty space between spears, NO character, NO labels, NO scenery or grid. Output a transparent RGBA sheet.
